## Financial Security

### Holiday Bonus

GitLab provides an annual Holiday Bonus to recognize your contributions and support your financial wellbeing. This valuable benefit adds meaningful value to your total compensation package.

Eligibility Requirements

- All GitLab France S.A.S. team members
- Must be employed during June to receive bonus
- Based on prior 12 months of employment (June 1 - May 31)

Key Features

- 1% of total gross compensation from previous 12 months
- Includes base salary, bonuses, commissions, and overtime
- Subject to social charges and income tax
- Paid automatically - no enrollment required

Payment Details

- Payment date: June payroll each year
- Calculation period: June 1 through May 31

## Financial Security

### Vacation Money (Vakantiegeld)

Netherlands team members receive the customary vacation money payment each May, as defined by the government.

Key Features

* Paid annually in May
* Amount determined by [government regulations](https://www.rijksoverheid.nl/onderwerpen/vakantiedagen-en-vakantiegeld/vraag-en-antwoord/hoe-hoog-is-mijn-vakantiegeld)

* Statutory Sick Leave
  * Team members who are unable to work due to illness are entitled to 70% of their salary for up to 104 weeks. This leave runs concurrently with GitLab's [Sick Time Policy](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/).
